from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    regions = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen.add((r,c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            if area >= 10 and len(cells) >= 8 and len(cells)/area >= 0.55:
                regions.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print('written',p)
